# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Linux x64 jobs run on the registered AWS EC2 self-hosted runner with the exact selector `[self-hosted, linux, x64, ci-linux]`. Matrix jobs may use the equivalent `ci-linux` custom label when the matrix is emitted as JSON. The runner must be a dedicated, clean/ephemeral CI host with no long-lived credentials; PR-controlled code must not inherit deploy keys, cloud credentials, or mutable global Git configuration. Keep `persist-credentials: false` on checkouts that execute repository code.

The current EC2 runner is Linux x64 only. Keep `ubuntu-24.04-arm` for native Linux ARM64 builds, `windows-latest`/`windows-2025` for native Windows validation, and `macos-latest` for native macOS validation. Those are platform requirements, not a return to hosted Linux CI. The pull-request `windows` job runs Windows Node under Wine on the Linux self-hosted runner and remains an explicit skipped check under the AWS/Linux policy; native Windows jobs stay independently available on hosted Windows.

`ci.yml` is pull-request-only; the self-hosted Linux serial reference, the `wine-apt-cache` seeder, and the self-hosted manual measurements live in `ci-master.yml` (master-push + `workflow_dispatch`). Because `ci-master.yml` does not listen to `pull_request`, those master-only jobs never appear in PR check panels (a job a workflow defines for a given event is listed and shows `skipped` when its `if` is false); keeping them in a separate workflow is what stops PR check circles from showing gray segments. Any new workflow or runner matrix must use the approved selectors and pass the repository runner-policy tests.
